text: This is the Aegis-12 Fiduciary Dashboard. On the left, policy rules enforce hard limits on agents.
Triggering a live intent stream sends a micro-transaction to real hardware inside a Phala TDX enclave.
The request routes through our Fiduciary Firewall. DCAP verified. The transaction is submitted to Solana Devnet.
Here in the Verifier Registry, you can see the real transaction hash anchoring the proof.
Now, the circuit breaker. We simulate a malicious agent attempting an unauthorized drain.
Lockdown initiated. The enclave is sealed. The private key physically cannot sign any more transactions.
We recover with a multisig override and trigger another transaction to prove system resilience.
Every action is cryptographically anchored. This is the mathematical cage.
